channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: Delhi chokes as AQI nears 'severe' level
item.description: According to the CPCB data, Wazirpur registered the highest AQI at 445, followed by Vivek Vihar at 444, Jahangirpuri at 442, Anand Vihar at 439, and 437 each in Ashok Vihar and Rohini.

item.title: AP’s ‘land at 99p/acre’ offer lands Cognizant’s new campus in Vizag
item.description: Along with IT major Cognizant, these companies are expected to generate about 41,700 jobs.

item.title: Higher food prices push retail inflation by nearly three times
item.description: Consumer Price Index-based retail inflation remained below the RBI’s 4 per cent inflation target for the 10th month in a row. Also, November is the second month when retail inflation has remained below 1 per cent level in the current CPI series which has data from 2014.

item.title: Iran raises gasoline prices for first time since deadly 2019 protests
item.description: Even at that new rate, Iranian gasoline prices remain among the lowest in the world.

item.title: Trump sued by preservationists seeking reviews and congressional approval for ballroom project
item.description: The president already has bypassed the federal government's usual building practices and historical reviews with the East Wing demolition. He recently added another architectural firm to the project.

item.title: Three influential US lawmakers introduce resolution to end 50 pc tariffs imposed by Trump on India
item.description: Trump has imposed a 50 per cent tariff on India, the highest in the world, including 25 per cent for Delhi’s purchases of Russian oil.

item.title: Land deal row: Revenue officials should have refused faulty registrations, says Ajit Pawar
item.description: His comments come against the backdrop of a notice issued by the deputy registrar to the firm of his son, Parth Pawar, seeking Rs 21 crore in stamp duty and penalties in connection with a controversial land deal in Pune.

item.title: Reversing prediabetes can reduce heart attack risk by nearly 60 pc: Study
item.description: This finding is especially important in light of recent research showing that lifestyle changes alone -- including exercise, weight loss, and dietary improvements -- do not lower cardiovascular risk in people with prediabetes.

item.title: Rajinikanth visits Tirupati with family to offer prayers
item.description: Rajinikanth was accompanied by his entire family, including his daughters Aishwarya and Soundarya, during his visit to the temple.

item.title: Chennai: YouTuber 'Savukku' Shankar arrested
item.description: Five others of the political commentator’s team were also arrested.
